variants.name: .338 Norma
variants.info:
Loads your C14 with .338 Norma Magnum.
This cartridge was developed to surpass the performance of .338 Lapua Magnum. Having a shorter cartridge length.
While it does not travel as fast and torso kill as far, it focuses on improving your firing speed!

variants.name: .308 Win.
variants.info:
A .308 Winchester conversion kit for the Timberwolf, turning it into the lighter Coyote rifle.
Possesses a simpler damage profile that allows you to kill to the torso up close, but lacks the raw power and performance of the other available ammo types.

variants.name: Tracerless
variants.info:
Ammo that doesn't have the components that create weapon tracers.

Greater overall accuracy for less range performance and bullet penetration.

variants.name: .408 CheyTac
variants.info:
A .408 Chey Tac conversion kit for the Timberwolf rifle.
Possesses much higher damage and penetrative power, but comes at the cost of being more cumbersome to use.
